caption: The drawing consists of two main objects placed vertically on a light beige background with a fine border line. The upper object is a circular, flat item depicted in gray tones, possibly representing metal or stone, with detailed shading to show relief. The face of the circle features three horizontal, segmented, worm-like or centipede-like figures in the center, each with numerous short, evenly spaced projections, surrounded by a raised border that includes swirling decorative elements and four larger dots or nubs. To the left of the central decoration are three vertical shapes resembling stylized numbers or glyphs. Below the circular object is a simple, technical elevation view (profile with cross-section) of a handle with a short, wide, rectangular top and a long, narrow, tapering rectangular stem, aligned to suggest it attaches to the back of the round object above. A small scale in inches is present in the bottom left corner. At the lower right of the drawing, the name "F. CHOATE" is written. All lines and shading are rendered in black or dark gray pencil or ink.
title: Butter Mold
